description: Javni linijski prijevoz u cestovnom prometu Koprivničko-križevačke županije is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Koprivničko-križevačka županija. The public regular transport model defines 79 bus lines – 44 county lines and 35 inter-county lines on which the buses of four carriers will operate (Čazmatrans promet d.o.o., Crafts for Transport and Services, Company Željko Šubić, Podravina Express Tours d.o.o., Autoprijevoznički obrt Škriljak), which will cover as much as one and a half million ... Coverage: Koprivničko-križevačka županija. The portal shows the English title as "Public regular transport in road transport of Koprivnica-Križevci County" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Koprivničko-križevačka županija. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
